welcome.title: Time tracking shouldn't feel like homework.
welcome.body:
Run the timer as you work. Log entries in seconds. Earn XP for showing up.

Let's get you rolling in under a minute.

openTimer.title: Open the Timer tab
openTimer.body: This is where you live-track time. Tap it to continue.

startClock.title: Start the clock
startClock.body: Hit Start — don't worry about the details yet. You fill them in while the timer runs.

pickClient.title: Pick a client
pickClient.body: Tap the field, then type to filter. Try 'DevCore' for this first run.
pickClient.hint: Start typing — the list narrows as you go.

pickProject.title: Pick a project
pickProject.body: Open the project menu and select 'Utbildning/Seminarium'.

describe.title: What are you doing?
describe.body: Type a short description. 'learning to track time!' works for now.

openToday.title: Your day at a glance
openToday.body: Tap Today. It's your dashboard — stats, progress, everything you logged.

todayStats.title: Today's numbers
todayStats.body: Hours logged today, your current streak, and this week's total. Streak resets if you skip a weekday.

todayEntries.title: Entries live here
todayEntries.body:
Every entry you log shows up here grouped by client.

▶ resumes a task · double-click to edit · ✕ deletes.

openLog.title: Log past entries
openLog.body: Tap +Log. Use this tab to backfill time or log without the timer.

logHours.title: Type hours directly
logHours.body: No timer, no problem. Use +/- or type 1:30 / 1.5 to set the hours, then save.

openXp.title: Achievements & XP
openXp.body: Tap XP. Every minute tracked earns XP.

xpLevel.title: Level up
xpLevel.body: Every 1000 XP gets you a new level. Higher levels unlock cooler titles — aim for Principal Dev.

xpAchievements.title: Unlock achievements
xpAchievements.body: Hit milestones like first entry, 7-day streak, or 10h in a day to unlock these badges.

done.title: You're all set! 🎉
done.body:
Your timer is running and you know where everything lives.

Shake the window to hide it, dock it as a top bar from the footer, or just keep working.

Have fun!
